title: I met someone irl
content: I was out with friends and a friend of their daughter's was talking about her mall world dreams. Except she didn't know anyone else had them. I got excited and told her about my dreams and that we aren't the only ones. When I got describing who I am there, and what my job is, she recognized me. And teased me for my appearance here. I don't look the same, for one I'm much shorter. (anyone else find that their appearance is different?) We cried. It was a lot to process. Then she embarrassingly told my friends tales of embarrassing things I've done in my dreams. Ever have a teenager describe your dreams from her point of view? It was uncomfortable, I felt like someone was rifling around in my brain. Surreal. But, also, I'm kind of a badass. From her point of view. I saved her from the tsunami. So, can someone tell me how this makes sense, at all? I feel so crazy. But, if I'm crazy, she is crazy. Or she is just psychic and messing with me, or some kind of cold reading prodigy? But she knew my nickname. And I've never so much as written it down. So, on a scale of 1 to 10, how insane am I? If someone has a logical explanation, I would love to hear it because I'm unsettled. Also, I would love to meet you all now. I'm insanely curious.
